etcd is part of 3 of my public repositories, from 2014 to 2025.

What it was for: [Systems and infrastructure](@/projects/systems.md) (2) and [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (1).

Most recently: [microcrawler](@/work/microcrawler.md); [cluster-kubernetes](@/work/cluster-kubernetes.md): Kubernetes Cluster; [apollon](@/work/apollon.md): Your own personal cluster built on top of the cloud.

1 of these projects runs as a live site.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses etcd: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links etcd to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
